zh.principle:
**标准**：SM2 公钥密码算法（SM2 Public Key Cryptography Algorithm）。### 曲线与密钥

SM2 在 256 位素数域椭圆曲线上实现签名、加密和密钥交换，签名把 SM3、用户 ID 与曲线参数绑定。基点 G 的阶为 n，私钥 d 在 [1, n−1]，公钥 P = [d]G。标准分五部分：总则、数字签名、密钥交换、公钥加密、参数定义。### 签名

签名先计算 ZA = SM3(ENTL||ID||a||b||xG||yG||xA||yA)，再计算 e = SM3(ZA||M)。选随机 k，计算 (x1,y1) = [k]G，r = (e+x1) mod n；若 r = 0 或 r+k = n 重选。s = ((1+d)^−1)(k−r d) mod n。验证计算 t = (r+s) mod n、[s]G+[t]P，再用 x1 恢复 R 并比较 r。### 加密与密钥交换

加密用接收方公钥：C1 = [k]G，共享点 [k]P = (x2,y2)，t = KDF(x2||y2,klen)，C2 = M⊕t，C3 = SM3(x2||M||y2)，密文为 C1||C3||C2。密钥交换用双方私钥与对方公钥计算共享点，再把 xA||yA||ZA||ZB 等输入 KDF 导出会话密钥。
zh.why: SM2 是中国商用密码体系的公钥底座。它用一条 256 位曲线同时承载签名、加密和密钥交换，并用 SM3 把用户身份、曲线参数和消息绑定进签名，形成可互操作的国密公钥基础设施。与 RSA 相比，SM2 的密钥和签名更短，签名速度更快；代价是曲线参数、用户 ID 和随机数 k 的管理更复杂。它的价值不是“替代某一个算法”，而是把证书、电子签章、TLCP 和金融终端拉到同一套公钥标准上。
zh.used: SM2 签名用于证书、电子签章、代码签名、身份认证和区块链；SM2 加密用于会话密钥封装和敏感数据加密；SM2 密钥交换用于 TLCP、VPN、政务专网。TLCP 采用双证书：签名证书证明身份，加密证书参与密钥交换。工程要点：签名和验签必须使用相同的用户 ID 与曲线参数；不要把 SM2 签名直接当 ECDSA 的 DER 签名使用；私钥应存放在密码模块/智能卡中，随机数 k 必须每次新鲜。
zh.broken: SM2 的安全性依赖椭圆曲线离散对数、SM3 和随机数 k。k 重用、偏置或故障注入会泄露私钥；曲线参数替换、无效点攻击、侧信道和错误处理也是现实风险。
zh.history:
SM2 由国家密码管理局组织制定，2010 年 12 月公开发布；2012 年发布 GM/T 0003 系列行业标准；2016 年 8 月发布 GB/T 32918 系列国家标准，2017 年 3 月实施，2017 年 5 月发布参数定义部分。2018 年 11 月，SM2 数字签名进入 ISO/IEC 14888-3:2018。它的历史意义不只是“国产 ECC”，而是把签名、加密、密钥交换和曲线参数放进同一套标准，形成可互操作的商用密码公钥体系。

**技术参数与复算边界**

该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：SM2 公钥密码算法的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 SM2 公钥密码算法 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

**参数与状态规模**

公式 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\) 的输入、输出和单位必须逐项登记；复算顺序为：1. 读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数 2. 按标准表换算等效强度 3. 取最弱分量作为系统强度。

状态规模、密钥长度、分组长度和轮数决定复杂度；这些量不能从标题推断，必须以标准或实现文档为准。

en.principle:
**Standard**: SM2 Public Key Cryptography Algorithm (SM2 公钥密码算法). ### Curve and keys

SM2 implements signatures, encryption and key exchange over a 256-bit prime-field elliptic curve; signing binds SM3, the user ID and the curve parameters. The base point G has order n, the private key is d in [1, n−1] and the public key is P = [d]G. The standard has five parts: general, digital signature, key exchange, public-key encryption and parameters. ### Signature

Signing first computes ZA = SM3(ENTL || ID || a || b || xG || yG || xA || yA), then e = SM3(ZA || M). Pick a random k, compute (x1, y1) = [k]G and r = (e + x1) mod n; if r = 0 or r + k = n, restart. Then s = ((1 + d)^−1)(k − r d) mod n. Verification computes t = (r + s) mod n and [s]G + [t]P, recovers x1 and checks R = r. ### Encryption and key exchange

Encryption uses the recipient’s public key: C1 = [k]G, shared point [k]P = (x2, y2), t = KDF(x2 || y2, klen), C2 = M ⊕ t, C3 = SM3(x2 || M || y2), and ciphertext C1 || C3 || C2. Key exchange computes a shared point from both private keys and the peer’s public key, then feeds xA || yA || ZA || ZB and related values into the KDF to derive a session key.
en.why:
SM2 is the public-key base of China’s commercial cryptography system. One 256-bit curve carries signatures, encryption and key exchange, and SM3 binds the user identity, curve parameters and message into the signature, creating an interoperable national public-key infrastructure.

Compared with RSA, SM2 keys and signatures are shorter and signing is faster; the price is more complex management of curve parameters, the user ID in ZA and the random k. Its value is not “replacing one algorithm” but bringing certificates, electronic seals, TLCP and financial terminals onto one public-key standard.
en.used:
SM2 signatures are used in certificates, electronic seals, code signing, identity authentication and blockchains; SM2 encryption wraps session keys and protects sensitive data; SM2 key exchange serves TLCP, VPNs and government networks. TLCP uses dual certificates: a signing certificate proves identity and an encryption certificate participates in key exchange.

Engineering rules: signing and verification must use the same user ID and curve parameters; do not treat SM2 signatures as ECDSA DER signatures without a defined profile; keep private keys in modules or smart cards; and generate a fresh k for every signature.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken:
SM2 security rests on the elliptic-curve discrete logarithm, SM3 and the random k. Reused, biased or fault-injected k can leak the private key; curve-parameter substitution, invalid-point attacks, side channels and error handling are also real risks.

Boundaries: SM2 is not symmetric encryption and cannot protect bulk data alone; it does not replace certificate chains, revocation, timestamps or auditing. Deployments must validate curve parameters and public points, enforce r, s in [1, n−1], and use side-channel-resistant implementations.
en.history:
OSCCA published SM2 in December 2010, issued the GM/T 0003 series in 2012, and published the GB/T 32918 series in August 2016, effective March 2017; the parameter-definition part followed in May 2017. In November 2018, the SM2 signature mechanism entered ISO/IEC 14888-3:2018.

Its historical significance is not merely “a Chinese ECC”. It put signatures, encryption, key exchange and curve parameters into one standard family, creating an interoperable commercial public-key system.
